items.summary: MCP server so AI agents can read and interact with the Elysium chain (Kinetiq's Arbitrum Orbit L2 for Hyperliquid). An agent can read blocks, balances, contracts, and logs over JSON-RPC, and can query the block explorer when that API is configured. Sending transactions is a separate switch, and it accepts only Elysium testnet (chain ID 99801). Write tools stay unregistered until ENABLE_WRITES=true, and the process accepts them only on chain ID 99801. For a first connection, follow Start here, then the prompts in Examples.
